title: ModLearn Lab: stepwise mathematics tutoring with a locally hosted language model
description: Web platform of the ModLearn Technology Lab at the Pädagogische Hochschule Vorarlberg. Children get graded help with mathematics tasks from a language model that runs on the institution's own hardware behind a private network; teachers run the sessions, put tasks into them and read every dialogue. An optional, teacher-enabled quality-assurance path sends only masked task text to an external model. Includes the benchmark of the help pipeline with 60 own tasks and simulated children.
